name: MOT17: Multiple Object Tracking Benchmark 2017
description: MOT17 is a standard multi-object tracking benchmark from the MOTChallenge consortium for tracking pedestrians in unconstrained urban environments. It comprises 14 physical video sequences (7 training and 7 test sequences) with 11,235 frames total (5,316 train, 5,919 test) captured from both moving and static cameras in crowded streets and public squares. Ground-truth pedestrian trajectories are annotated with high precision, including occlusion and visibility ratios. For benchmark standardization, each sequence is paired with public detections from 3 baseline detectors: DPM, Faster R-CNN, and SDP, yielding 42 detector-specific evaluation subsets.
